notes: TBox rule edit. No real exceptions: POSIX fixes '/' for Unix-like systems (classic Mac OS used ':' but is not Unix-like). New members Pellucid OS and Tessaly OS are invented and named in the prompt, so the rule is their only route (determinate). Linux is the well-known member whose separator is stored by name in very many paths, so it splits by storage (background_beliefs). The near query avoids Windows' separator, which is the new answer (R6).
